model.memory: three shared entity-local GRU banks, one timestamp per entity
model.retrieval: all eight slots; hard routing score not trained in this study

objectives.teacher: joint plus joint supervision at one-step student-encountered service/inspection state

teacher_control: Same base examples and updates, but teacher arm performs additional forward/backward computation and receives extra labeled receipt states. Measure rather than claim equal compute.
frozen_intervention: Freeze observation encoder and all memory writers before optimizer; action predictor remains trainable. Same initialization within seed.
selection: Per-arm threshold on calibration cost; preserve native expected-cost threshold 0.25 as separate endpoint. No evaluation-based arm selection.
primary: paired physical cost versus forecast-only, failures guard; exact public-history reference remains control
audit: checkpoint reconstruction of all calibration and evaluation predictions
all three seeds before aggregate interpretation
limitations: one-step simulator teaching is inspired by semantic action supervision, not an ActionOPD reproduction
no retention-loss or SSM superiority claim
